title: TOURNE
description: A pottery studio where you sculpt a vessel on a real-time 3D wheel: scroll to pull the clay, drag the profile, choose the glaze, then order it.
stack: Next.js 16 · React 19 · Three.js · Lenis · Tailwind v4

sections.title: Main Landing Page
sections.summary: Build an isolated Next.js 16 / React 19 / TypeScript / Tailwind v4 landing page at `/tourne` for a fictional pottery studio in Tacoma, Washington. Use `three` (WebGL) and `lenis`. Everything lives in `src/app/(tourne)/` and imports only npm
sections.customCodeReason: Uses custom motion or 3D runtime dependencies alongside native Webflow layout elements.
